programmes.d: Zoe is upset after seeing Wade flirting. Wade turns to Lavon for guidance, but soon finds himself in even worse trouble. George and AnnaBeth try to make their own new adventures.
Brick thinks Lavon and Wade are leading him to a surprise party for his birthday, but they have really invited him to go fishing. Lemon and Zoe make plans to have a girls' day.
The town panics after AnnaBeth is visited in a dream by BlueBell's founder, who prophesies five omens about the end of BlueBell. George gets a potentially life-changing offer.
In the season finale, Zoe makes a life-changing decision and Wade does his best to make it happen before their baby is born. Lavon determines to make things right with Lemon.
Rachel Bilson stars in this fish-out-of-water series about a New York City doctor adjusting to life in a small southern town.
Zoe agrees to join the mayor on his float during the Founder's Day parade, but Lemon and the residents of BlueBell see Zoe's efforts to make nice more like crashing the event.
Zoe hopes to win BlueBell's gumbo contest ... and get some patients. Lavon develops a crush on Brick (TIM MATHESON) and Zoe's new receptionist (NADINE VELAZQUEZ).
Inhibitions are lost during a heat wave, even Zoe's and her attraction to Wade. Lemon's emotions get the best of her when she sees Lavon with his date, Didi (NADINE VELAZQUEZ).
Zoe is in the center of a town scandal when she discovers something shocking about the local minister and his wife. Lemon must convince Lavon to choose her funding proposal.
Zoe thinks she's seen a ghost. Plus, her mother (Jobeth Williams) comes to town in hopes of reconciling with Zoe, and Lavon won't authorize Lemon and George's dream home purchase.
Zoe is asked out by a handsome veterinarian (Wes Brown -- True Blood), and when Nascar's Brian Vickers drops out of co-hosting an event with Lemon, Lavon replaces him.
George and Wade hatch a plan to get even with their high school nemesis, Jimmy (Sean Carrigan); when Lemon catches wind of their scheme she wants in on the action, too.
BlueBell prepares for "Planksgiving." Lavon encourages Wade to be honest about his feelings for Zoe, and George's father (ERIC PIERPOINT) offers him an out-of-town opportunity.
It's Christmas in BlueBell. In flashbacks, we learn some of Lemon's history, including the details of when Lemon and Lavon first realized they had a connection.
Zoe searches some family history and discovers -- much to Lemon's displeasure -- that she is a legacy to the BlueBell Belles. Wade helps Lavon get back into the dating scene.
Zoe hides her new friendship with AnnaBeth (recurring guest star Kaitlyn Black), who doesn't want Lemon to find out. Lemon campaigns to become the Belles' new Memory Matron.
